root_cause: the default fixed-tick scheduler emitted at most 8 catch-up ticks and discarded excess accumulated authority time; a transient 250-400ms server stall therefore made authoritative movement cover less wall-clock time than client prediction
movement snapshots could be published while the authority was still behind, forcing the predicted client to reconcile against a deliberately incomplete server trajectory

the input buffer treated all continuous move/look samples as FIFO commands until the 64-entry hard limit, so stale movement states accumulated faster than they could be consumed during and after stalls
